05 / Our Story

Built local. Built to last.

Jay K Roofing & Construction started in 2005 with one principle: do the work like it's going on your own house. Two decades later we're still right here in Raleigh, still answering our own phones, still showing up when we say we will.

Rooted in Raleigh and the Triangle. We know these storms. We know these houses. And we stand behind every roof we put down — with a lifetime workmanship warranty and a phone we actually answer.

When you call Jay K, you're not getting a corporate sales pitch. You're getting Jay. And the same crew that's been doing this work for 20 years.

07 / Questions

Got questions? We've got answers.

Yes. Jay K Roofing & Construction holds a North Carolina contractor license, full general liability insurance, and workers' compensation coverage. We'll send you proof on request — and we recommend you ask every contractor for the same.
It depends on the size of your roof, pitch, the material you choose, and any decking repairs needed. That's why our estimates are free, on-site, and itemized — so you see exactly what you're paying for. Most residential roofs in the area fall between $8,000–$20,000. Book in winter and save $600 with code SAVE600.
Most residential roofs we complete in a single day. Larger or more complex roofs may take two. We arrive early, work efficiently, clean up completely, and walk you through the finished work before we leave.
Yes — this is one of our specialties. After storm damage, we document everything with photos and measurements, meet with your insurance adjuster on-site, and handle the paperwork. You pay your deductible; we handle the rest.
Two warranties: a manufacturer's warranty on the shingles (typically 25–50 years depending on the product you choose), plus our lifetime workmanship warranty. If our installation ever fails, we come back and fix it — free, for as long as you own the home.
We can help you explore financing options for larger projects. Call us at 570-225-1525 and we'll walk you through what's available so you can pick what works for your budget.
Raleigh, Cary, Durham, Apex, Wake Forest, Garner, and all of Wake County. We also serve much of the surrounding Triangle. Not sure if you're in our area? Just call.
